name: Bun rieu
summary: Bún riêu is named with hủ tiếu and coffee as breakfast on the Cái Răng boats. Sở Văn hóa, Thể thao và Du lịch thành phố Cần Thơ lists it and does not print a recipe.
origin: The department’s Cái Răng listing. A recipe was not printed.
howToEat: On the boat at the market, at dawn.
seoTitle: Bun rieu on the Cai Rang boats
seoDescription: Bún riêu is breakfast on the Cái Răng boats, named by the Can Tho tourism department. A recipe was not printed.
